name: Web Scrape Rate Limiter API
shortDescription: Compute a polite, crawl-delay-compliant scrape schedule — safe RPS, inter-request delay, concurrency, ETA
description: Agent-native, defensive scrape scheduler computed in pure math — no fetch, no LLM. /plan takes a robots crawl-delay (if any), desired RPS, concurrency, and page count and returns a polite, compliant schedule: safe RPS, effective RPS, inter-request delay, concurrency cap, throttle/violation flags, and total ETA. It only ever reduces aggressiveness to honor crawl-delay and politeness defaults. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and compliance notes. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.
